stage_evidence: Official MOSTA stage-separated E14.5_E1S3 listing and observed download URL; file contains one section, no pooled stage field. Stage assigned at file level, not inferred from expression.
genotype_context: Normal C57BL/6 embryo organogenesis resource per official MOSTA home; no perturbation source
attribution: Chen et al. Cell 2022 DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2022.04.003; STDS0000058, STOmicsDB
official_rule: https://virtualembryo.ai/challenge/rules section 10 explicitly permits external stages after E13.5 with licence and disclosure. Source is spatial Stereo-seq, not ambiguous external scRNA-only permission.
allowed_fields: layers/count restricted to author anatomical Heart bins
exact panel gene identifiers and presence mask
full-transcriptome raw row totals only for new normalisation/audit
excluded_fields: All embeddings, trajectories, cross-stage fits and original uns metadata
No E9.5 external data in dev model or dev selection
selection_provenance: Original MOSTA paper methods: spatially constrained clustering per section, markers plus anatomical annotation; only broad anatomical Heart label used. Fixed pre-inspection CM enrichment rule uses at least 2 positive raw genes among Tnnt2,Tnni3,Actc1,Myh6,Myh7,Myl2,Myl7. No integrated-stage reference label transfer used.
limitations: Mixed spatial bins, not pure cardiomyocyte single cells
Only one sagittal section from one late endpoint; dissection and cell-composition confounding
Full 500 columns include missing-gene placeholders; var.measured_in_source must be applied
Does not establish future target timing, effect sign, organ size or proportions
E14.5 may inform a hypothesis, not replace the E10.5/E12.5 target
17 genes absent by exact symbol; no alias inference applied
validation: 1079 anatomical Heart bins; all satisfy frozen CM enrichment rule
All retained raw counts finite, nonnegative and integer
500 genes in exact T2 official order
No copied learned metadata or spatial coordinates in emitted h5ad
